13.odr_com: And he set Ephraim on his right hand, that is, on the left hand of Israel: but Manasses on his owne left hand, to wit, on his fathers right hand, and put them nere to him.

13.madueke_b: And he set Ephraim on his right hand, that is, on the left hand of Israel: but Manasses on his own left hand, to wit, on his father's right hand, and put them near to him.

14.s_dismas: Who ſtretching forth his right hand, put it vpon the head of Ephraim the younger brother: and the left vpon the head of Manaſſes, that was the elder, changing handes.
14.odr_com: Who stretching forth his right hand, put it vpon the head of Ephraim the younger brother: and the left vpon the head of Manasses, that was the elder, changing handes.
14.sabates_a: Who stretching forth his right hand, put it upon the head of Ephraim the younger brother: and the left upon the head of Manasses, that was the elder, changing hands.
14.madueke_b: Who stretching forth his right hand, put it upon the head of Ephraim the younger brother: and the left upon the head of Manasses, that was the elder, changing hands.

15.s_dismas: And Iacob bleſſed the ſonnes of Ioſeph, and ſaid: God, in whoſe ſight my fathers Abraham and Iſaac haue walked, God that feedeth me from my youth vntil this preſent day:
15.odr_com: And Iacob blessed the sonnes of Ioseph, and said: God, in whose sight my fathers Abraham and Isaac haue walked, God that feedeth me from my youth vntil this present day:
15.sabates_a: And Jacob blessed the sons of Joseph, and said: God, in whose sight my fathers Abraham & Isaac have walked, God that feedeth me from my youth until this present day:
15.madueke_b: And Jacob blessed the sons of Joseph, and said: God, in whose sight my fathers Abraham & Isaac have walked, God that feedeth me from my youth until this present day:

16.s_dismas: The Angel that deliuereth me from al euils, bleſſe theſe children: and be my name called vpon them, the names alſo of my fathers Abraham, and Iſaac, and grow they into a multitude vpon the earth.
16.odr_com: The Angel that deliuereth me from al euils, blesse these children: and be my name called vpon them, the names also of my fathers Abraham, and Isaac, and grow they into a multitude vpon the earth.
16.sabates_a: The Angel that delivereth me from all evils, bless these children: and be my name called upon them, the names also of my fathers Abraham, and Isaac, and grow they into a multitude upon the earth.
16.madueke_b: The Angel that delivereth me from all evils, bless these children: and be my name called upon them, the names also of my fathers Abraham, and Isaac, and grow they into a multitude upon the earth.

17.s_dismas: And Ioſeph ſeing that his father had put his right hand vpon the head of Ephraim, tooke it heauily: and taking his fathers hand he went about to lift it from Ephraims head, and to remoue it vpon the head of Manaſſes.
17.odr_com: And Ioseph seing that his father had put his right hand vpon the head of Ephraim, tooke it heauily: and taking his fathers hand he went about to lift it from Ephraims head, and to remoue it vpon the head of Manasses.
17.sabates_a: And Joseph seeing that his father had put his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, took it heavily: and taking his father's hand he went about to lift it from Ephraim's head & to remove it upon the head of Manasses.
17.madueke_b: And Joseph seeing that his father had put his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, took it heavily: and taking his father's hand he went about to lift it from Ephraim's head & to remove it upon the head of Manasses.

18.s_dismas: And he ſaid to his father: It is not conuenient father ſo to be: becauſe this is the firſt begotten put thy right hand vpon his head.
18.odr_com: And he said to his father: It is not conuenient father so to be: because this is the first begotten put thy right hand vpon his head.
18.sabates_a: And he said to his father: It is not convenient father so to be: because this is the first-begotten put thy right hand upon his head.
18.madueke_b: And he said to his father: It is not convenient father so to be: because this is the first-begotten put thy right hand upon his head.

19.s_dismas: Who refuſing, ſaid: I know my ſonne, I know: and this ſame in dede ſhal be into peoples, and ſhal be multiplied: but his younger brother ſhal be greater then he: and his ſede ſhal growe into nations.
19.odr_com: Who refusing, said: I know my sonne, I know: and this same in dede shal be into peoples, and shal be multiplied: but his younger brother shal be greater then he: and his sede shal growe into nations.
19.sabates_a: Who refusing, said: I know my son, I know: and this same indeed shall be into peoples, and shall be multiplied: but his younger brother shall be greater than he: and his seed shall grow into nations.
19.madueke_b: Who refusing, said: I know my son, I know: and this same indeed shall be into peoples, and shall be multiplied: but his younger brother shall be greater than he: and his seed shall grow into nations.

20.s_dismas: And he bleſſed them at that time, ſaying: In thee ſhal Iſrael be bleſſed, and it ſhal be ſaid: God do vnto thee as vnto Ephraim, and as vnto Manaſſes. And he ſette Ephraim before Manaſſes.
20.odr_com: And he blessed them at that time, saying: In thee shal Israel be blessed, and it shalbe said: God do vnto thee as vnto Ephraim, and as vnto Manasses. And he sette Ephraim before Manasses.
20.sabates_a: And he blessed them at that time, saying: In thee shall Israel be blessed, and it shall be said: God do unto thee as unto Ephraim, & as unto Manasses. And he set Ephraim before Manasses.
20.madueke_b: And he blessed them at that time, saying: In thee shall Israel be blessed, and it shall be said: God do unto thee as unto Ephraim, & as unto Manasses. And he set Ephraim before Manasses.

21.s_dismas: And he ſaid to Ioſeph his ſonne: Behold I dye, and God wil be with you, and wil bring you backe into the land of your fathers.
21.odr_com: And he said to Ioseph his sonne: Behold I dye, and God wil be with you, and wil bring you backe into the land of your fathers.
21.sabates_a: And he said to Joseph his son: Behold I die, & God will be with you, and will bring you back into the land of your fathers.
21.madueke_b: And he said to Joseph his son: Behold I die, & God will be with you, and will bring you back into the land of your fathers.

22.s_dismas: I doe geue thee one portion aboue thy brethren, which I tooke out of the hand of the Amorrhean with my ſword and bowe.
22.odr_com: I doe geue thee one portion aboue thy brethren, which I tooke out of the hand of the Amorrhean with my sword and bowe.
22.sabates_a: I do give thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorrhean with my sword and bow.
22.madueke_b: I do give thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorrhean with my sword and bow.

janvier_by_verse.1: These things being so done, it was told Joseph that his father was sick: who, taking his two sons Manasses and Ephraim, went forward.
janvier_by_verse.2: And it was told the old man: Behold thy son Joseph cometh to thee. Who being strengthened sat on his bed.
janvier_by_verse.3: And Joseph being entered in to him, he said: God Almighty appeared to me in Luza, which is in the Land of Chanaan: and he blessed me,
janvier_by_verse.4: and said: I will increase, and multiply thee, and make thee into multitudes of peoples: and I will give thee this land, and to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
janvier_by_verse.5: Thy two sons therefore which were born to thee in the Land of Ægypt before I came hither to thee, shall be mine: Ephraim and Manasses, as Ruben and Simeon shall be reputed to me.
janvier_by_verse.6: But the rest begotten of thee after them, shall be thine, and shall be called by the name of their brethren in their possessions.
janvier_by_verse.7: For unto me, when I came out of Mesopotamia, Rachel died in the land of Chanaan in the very journey, and it was spring time: and I entered into Ephrata, and buried her by the way side to Ephrata, which by another name is called Bethleem.
janvier_by_verse.8: And seeing his sons he said to him: Who are these?
janvier_by_verse.9: He answered: They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. Bring them, quoth he, to me, that I may bless them.
janvier_by_verse.10: For Israel's eyes were dim by reason of very great age, and he could not see clearly. And when they were set beside him, kissing and embracing them,
janvier_by_verse.11: he said to his son: I am not defrauded of thy sight, moreover God hath shewed me thy seed.
janvier_by_verse.12: And when Joseph had taken them from his father's lap, he adored prostrate unto the ground.
janvier_by_verse.13: And he set Ephraim on his right hand, that is, on the left hand of Israel: but Manasses on his own left hand, to wit, on his father's right hand, and put them near to him.
janvier_by_verse.14: Who stretching forth his right hand, put it upon the head of Ephraim the younger brother: and the left upon the head of Manasses, that was the elder, changing hands.
janvier_by_verse.15: And Jacob blessed the sons of Joseph, and said: God, in whose sight my fathers Abraham & Isaac have walked, God that feedeth me from my youth until this present day:
janvier_by_verse.16: The Angel that delivereth me from all evils, bless these children: and be my name called upon them, the names also of my fathers Abraham, and Isaac, and grow they into a multitude upon the earth.
janvier_by_verse.17: And Joseph seeing that his father had put his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, took it heavily: and taking his father's hand he went about to lift it from Ephraim's head & to remove it upon the head of Manasses.
janvier_by_verse.18: And he said to his father: It is not convenient father so to be: because this is the first-begotten put thy right hand upon his head.
janvier_by_verse.19: Who refusing, said: I know my son, I know: and this same indeed shall be into peoples, and shall be multiplied: but his younger brother shall be greater than he: and his seed shall grow into nations.
janvier_by_verse.20: And he blessed them at that time, saying: In thee shall Israel be blessed, and it shall be said: God do unto thee as unto Ephraim, & as unto Manasses. And he set Ephraim before Manasses.
janvier_by_verse.21: And he said to Joseph his son: Behold I die, & God will be with you, and will bring you back into the land of your fathers.
janvier_by_verse.22: I do give thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorrhean with my sword and bow.
